title: Open Pleated Festival Folding Fan
description: One original complete static Chinese-festival-inspired open folding-fan visual prop, displayed laid flat. A single continuous thick annular-sector fan leaf has eight genuine radial mountain folds and nine finite flat valley seats. One newly drawn continuous wooden skeleton joins nine slender radial ribs to a rounded pivot hub; eight fully open lower rib windows and eight complete under-pleat clearances are genuine air. A separate small faceted gold-coloured pivot head rests on its full circular seat. Three closed connected editable meshes and three opaque constant untextured PBR materials. Metres, native Z up, decorative face +Z, presentation front -Y and horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. The whole flat wooden skeleton back is grounded. All numerical model shapes are newly authored; no palm leaf, parasol, sextant, accordion, pinwheel, knot, cloth bolt or other existing geometry is imported, scaled, recoloured or combined. One whole prop and zero scenes; ribs and folds are constituent geometry, not extra assets. The wooden rib roots share one continuous fixed hub; the pivot head is decorative and no working hinge or separate moving leaves are represented. No writing, logo, texture, tassel, stand, person, animation or surrounding scene. Stylized game-art only: no historical or regional reconstruction, cultural authenticity, folding or opening motion, paper or cloth deformation, ventilation performance, handling suitability, attachment, load, stability, material properties, manufacture or safety certification. Dimensions describe game-space geometry only.
